label: Simulation
tagline: Intuitive visualisation of real-world physical or temporal systems
description: Researches the right representation paradigm for a domain (2d-spatial-map / 2d-isometric / 3d-environment / iconographic-anim / text-art / hybrid) and orchestrates 7 component drawers + the 3 quality lenses to produce a lens-verified runnable simulation embedded as a canvas card. 2d-isometric for stacked / axonometric briefs (SimCity, Habbo, Theme Hospital canon); text-art for TUI / ASCII / ANSI / htop-style monitors / pipeline status boards / retro-modem dashboards where the terminal aesthetic IS the medium. Runs 4-researcher fleet + synthesiser; user-steerage interrupt before any drawer fires; §8.3 loop-until-bar with 5-iteration cap; multi-draft at scene + loop cruxes via iterator-remix. Two cross-boundary contracts the orchestrator enforces beyond the per-drawer lens trios: §1.2 iframe ↔ host pointer + scroll contract (touch-action policy, overlay pointer-events budget, scroll-past affordance for hero-slot sims, wheel forwarding, pointer-capture cleanup) and §5.6 Phase F layered-interaction QA + fix pass the chat caller runs after Step-8 QA — catches violations no per-component lens can see because they live at the iframe ↔ host boundary no drawer owns.

triggers.title: build an app
triggers.rule: User says "build a web app / dashboard / page that monitors X system" with app-framing words. Top-level Claude scaffolds the app shell first (with sim-placeholder slot), then dispatches simulation-orchestrator per slot . After the orchestrator returns the hand-off envelope, top-level Claude drives the build phase per simulation-orchestrator.md §5.1.0 and embeds the runtime per §5.1.1.
